# AffordableHousing.com

> > AffordableHousing.com connects renters and property owners through a comprehensive platform for affordable housing search, Section 8 listings, and tenant management.

AffordableHousing.com is a dual-sided marketplace serving both renters seeking affordable housing and property owners managing Section 8 and subsidized rental properties. The platform includes B2B solutions for housing authorities through products like RevoList, CentralHub, and RentWatch.

## Key Topics

- Section 8 Housing
- Affordable Housing
- Property Listings
- Renter Portal
- Landlord Portal
- Account Authentication
- Property Management
- HUD Vouchers

- Sign-In
- RevoList
- CentralHub
- Rent Calculator

## Core Platforms

- [Homepage](https://www.affordablehousing.com): Homepage for affordable housing search and rental listings platform
- [Renter Portal](https://www.affordablehousing.com/renters): Renter portal for searching and applying to affordable housing
- [Owner Portal](https://www.affordablehousing.com/owners): Owner portal for property listing and tenant management tools
- [B2B Solutions](https://info.affordablehousing.com): B2B products for housing agencies: RentWatch, RevoList, CentralHub

## Property Search & Listings

- [All Rental Properties](https://www.affordablehousing.com/properties): Browse all rental properties and affordable housing listings
- [Apartments for Rent](https://www.affordablehousing.com/apartments): Search and filter affordable apartments available for rent
- [Houses for Rent](https://www.affordablehousing.com/houses): Search and filter affordable houses available for rent
- [Section 8 Housing](https://www.affordablehousing.com/properties/section8-owners): Section 8 housing listings and owner resources on platform

## Account Management & Authentication

- [User Login](https://www.affordablehousing.com/ll/dashboard.aspx): User login and authentication dashboard for AffordableHousing.com
- [My Account](https://www.affordablehousing.com/ll/ll_myaccount.aspx): User account management for owners and renters on platform
- [Tenant Account](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/tenantAccount/tenantAccount.aspx): Tenant account setup and management portal for renters
- [Alert Preferences](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/alertPreferences/alertPreferences.aspx): User alert preferences and notification settings management

## Renter Tools & Applications

- [Waitlist Applications](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/myWaitlistApplications/myWaitlistApplications.aspx): Renter waitlist applications tracking and management portal
- [Renter Inbox](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/renterInbox/renterInbox.aspx): Renter inbox for housing application messages and communications
- [Market Rent Estimator](https://www.affordablehousing.com/market-rent-estimator): Rent affordability calculator tool for estimating housing costs

## Owner & Landlord Resources

- [Owner Pricing](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/ownerPricing/pricing.aspx): Pricing plans for property owners listing on AffordableHousing.com
- [Owner Plans](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/ownerPricing/Plans.aspx): Owner account plans and subscription options for property listings

## Housing Authorities & Agencies

- [Housing Authorities Directory](https://www.affordablehousing.com/housing-authorities): Directory of housing authorities and Section 8 agencies by location
